name: Echeyakee
summary: At the Crossroads, hunters prepare to summon Echeyakee, the white lion of the northern Barrens. Sergra Darkthorn sends young Horde hunters to test their strength against him.

sections.title: Whitemist of the Savannah
sections.body: Across the central plains, a white-maned lion rules the savannah cats. Taur-ahe speakers call him Whitemist, or Echeyakee. Legend says he moves without a sound, like morning mist over red earth. His strikes are swift, and prey knows neither fear nor suffering. Local hunters honor him as a sign of mercy and swift death.

sections.title: The Trial of the Horn
sections.body:
At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn trains fledgling warriors. The experienced orc shaman sends them against the king of beasts once they have proven themselves against lesser savannah prowlers.

With a special horn, you travel northeast past the mountain ridges to a graveyard of massive kodo bones. Sound it to challenge Echeyakee and draw the elusive predator from hiding. There, your strength and cunning face their trial.

sections.title: The Lion's Legacy
sections.body: When you bring Echeyakee's hide back, Sergra says his hunting days are over, though his spirit lives on with the victor. She teaches that his example joins subtle strength with honor in mercy.

faq.q: What does the name Echeyakee mean?
faq.answer: In Taur-ahe, Echeyakee means “Whitemist.” The name honors his pale pelt and the silent way he stalks across the plains, like mist.
You summon Echeyakee northeast of the Crossroads, past the mountain ridge, among giant kodo skeletons. He appears when you sound the horn Sergra Darkthorn provides.

faq.q: Why is Echeyakee described as both mercy and death?
faq.answer: Tauren hunting tradition sees Echeyakee as both mercy and death because his strikes are swift and sure. His prey suffers no prolonged agony or fear.
Sergra Darkthorn, an orc shaman at the Crossroads, sends hunters after Echeyakee to test their grasp of a predator's subtlety and balance.

faq.q: What happens after Echeyakee is slain?
faq.answer: After Echeyakee is slain, Sergra asks you to bring his hide to her at the Crossroads as proof of the hunt.

faq.q: What follows the hunt of Echeyakee?
faq.answer: After you overcome Echeyakee with patience and lethal skill, Sergra Darkthorn sends you after more dangerous prey: the vicious raptors called scytheclaws.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know Echeyakee as Whitemist, a sacred figure of the clean, painless kill and an example of the Earth Mother's fierce balance.
As a hunter in the Barrens, you face a test of patience and stealth in the hunt for Echeyakee, famed among the savannah beasts for his pale fur and legendary name.
As a Horde champion at the Crossroads, you face the harsh wildlife of the Barrens in a rite of passage that proves your survival skills.
